purpose: Static protocol v1 wire expectations shared by independent Rust, TypeScript and Python checks.
integer_representation: u64 times, durations and all publication sequence numbers use decimal strings; optional values use null; omitted bundles use null; floats compare after format rounding.
maintenance: Static expected values and bytes are reviewed against the working specification, independently of application output. Sequence and acknowledgment traces express protocol behavior without prescribing application data structures.
